Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Savitri - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Kavita: "Yes, of course."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Kunal (surprised): "I really enjoyed today."
